name: excerpt
description: The excerpt plugin for Claude Code.

plugins.name: excerpt
plugins.description: A skill teaching agents to read Rust and TypeScript by item with the excerpt binary, an outline of what a file or directory declares and one item printed whole by name; a hook that blocks printing those files' lines through sed -n, awk, head, tail, or cat, and a subagent's whole-file Read of a long one; and a hook that gives each subagent that rule as it starts.
